title: Optimize indexed join probe container preallocation
constraints: Preserve indexed join probe, LIMIT, and left join semantics
rationale: The indexed join probe path has clear upper bounds for distinct probe keys, probe cache entries, and probed result rows. Preallocating these containers reduces HashSet, HashMap, and Vec growth during indexed joins.
steps: Preallocate distinct probe keys from left row count
Preallocate probed result rows from min(left row count, limit)
Preallocate probe cache from distinct probe key count
Verify indexed join probe and left join behavior
expected_impact: Reduces allocation churn in indexed join probe execution without changing join semantics.
